w5.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness adds Strands harness defaults, built-in tools, and lifecycle hooks
w5.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness now runs on the open-source Strands harness, bringing a recommended model, task-oriented defaults, automatic prompt caching, proactive context management, and new built-in tools. It also adds lifecycle hooks so you can run deterministic allow or deny checks at defined points in the agent loop.

w6.title: Amazon Polly launches voice cloning: A unique voice for your brand
w6.summary: Voice cloning in Amazon Polly is now generally available. Give Amazon Polly a few minutes of recordings from a consenting speaker, and it builds a custom voice that reads new text in that speaker's voice. Cloned voices run on the Amazon Polly generative engine and support seven languages.

w7.title: Optimize AI economics on Amazon Bedrock with Accenture’s sequenced approach
w7.summary: As enterprises scale AI on Amazon Bedrock, token spend can grow even as per-token prices fall. This post walks through six composable optimization levers, shows how Accenture applied them across four client engagements, and recommends a sequence for cutting AI token spend on your own workloads.

w8.title: From learning to leaderboard: How Cisco upskilled 1,200 engineers in agentic AI with AWS AI League
w8.summary: Cisco and AWS used Cisco Transformation Fest and AWS AI League to turn hands-on AI learning into a culture of building. A Cisco engineer won the 2025 AWS AI League global title and 1,200 engineers competed in 2026. This post shares Cisco's journey, lessons from the 2026 winning agent built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and how to host your own league.

w9.title: Keep inference running through regional capacity shortfalls with cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI
w9.summary: Cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI gives your application one invocation path across the endpoints and inference components you already run, in one or more AWS Regions and AWS accounts. The router prefers its own Region and shifts new requests to another destination only when the local one can't serve reliably.

w10.title: Protect agent tool calls with Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
w10.summary: Learn how Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway keep sensitive data out of the tools your AI agents call. Added as a gateway interceptor, Skyflow de-identifies data before any tool, model, or log sees it, and restores it for authorized callers, with no change to your agent code.

w11.title: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1 is now on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
w11.summary: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1, a reasoning model built for real-time complex dialog, is available today on AWS Marketplace and Amazon SageMaker JumpStart. Discover it, evaluate it on your own data, and deploy it to a secure SageMaker endpoint in your own AWS account.

w12.title: Using NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS
w12.summary: Learn how to run two memory-bounded Kubernetes Pods on a single NVIDIA A10G GPU using open-source NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS. This walkthrough builds a custom Amazon Linux 2023 image, installs KAI Scheduler and the GPU Fractioning Operator, and validates per-Pod GPU-memory contracts with enforcement and metrics.
